$comment: Resources this template needs bound on instantiate (none: it uses the durable workspace vector store). `requires: ["langchain"]` marks templates that need the @flowaid/nodes-langchain bundled plugin (features.langchain).
name: Knowledge assistant (LangChain RAG)
description: Answers questions from your own documents: LangChain loads, splits, embeds and retrieves (hybrid vector + BM25); TypeSafe judges relevance, safety and groundedness; low-confidence answers go to a reviewer.
